notes.note: Scope: the lineage lists 4 CRM write components; only 'Update Details from employer Fields CustomerAccount' is business logic. 'ETL Warning' and 'ETL Warning 1' (Create gen_etlprocesswarning) and 'ETL Record Finish' (Update gen_etlprocess) are ETL plumbing and are not mapped; their open script outputs (ErrorText, gen_etlprocessid) are intentionally left unresolved.

Always-sent attributes: gen_closingaccountdate (any valid Fund_Cloase_Date_51) and gen_bankstoppaymentsreceivingdate (= DateTime.Now when Is_Provision_Date_Update_131 or Is_Finish_Work_Date_150 is "1") have no CRM comparison, so those rows send an Update on every run and the 'receiving date' is re-stamped with the run time daily while the flag stays "1".

Clearing asymmetry: gen_stoppaymentsreason is cleared (null) when the file reason is blank, and gen_stoppaymentsreportdate is cleared when the file date is blank OR invalid (Dates Format returns NULL for wrong length / unparsable / < 1900), whereas gen_endemploymentdate, gen_closingaccountdate, gen_sourceaccount and gen_compensationeligibility are never cleared. A reason code that is non-numeric or not in the 15-code list is silently ignored (-1), with no warning.

gen_compensationeligibility is only ever set to OptionSetValue(1), driven by file Employer_Not_Eligible_Compensation_258 == "1" (together with gen_updateeligibilitydate = DateTime.Now); it is never reset to another value. The business meaning of option 1 versus the field name 'Employer Not Eligible Compensation' is not provable (CRM metadata not supplied).

Inconsistent account-number normalisation: 'Check CustomerAccount Exist' matches the RAW 12-char Bank_Account_Number_27 (untrimmed, unpadded) to gen_bankaccountnumber as stored, while 'Get Source Account' matches TRIMMED (not zero-padded) Source_Account_160 to right('000000000000'+Gen_bankaccountnumber,12). Rows whose source account does not match are silently left without gen_sourceaccount (IgnoreFailure).

Aggregate groups by all 14 columns (DISTINCT): exact duplicate rows are collapsed, but two file rows for the same customer account with different values both reach the writer (two Updates, last processed wins), and both compare against the CRM values cached before the data flow ran.

'Trim String Fields' only receives StopPaymentsReason, StopPaymentsReportDate and Source_Account_160; Employee_Work_End_Date_118 and Fund_Cloase_Date_51 reach 'Dates Format' untrimmed (switch on Trim().Length, Substring on the untrimmed value).

Dead items: output columns 'Column 1' and 'Column' (i4) of 'Convert StopPaymentsReason And CompensationEligibility to Int' are never assigned or consumed; Multicast Output 2 is dangling; Multicast Output 1 only feeds a row counter.
No staging tables: all lookups read CRM (Psql / ALTSHULER_MSCRM) directly; no direct SQL DML to CRM in this package.
